title: NuGet Package Management
description: Learn how to manage NuGet packages directly from the Solution Explorer.

steps.title: Opening the NuGet Manager
steps.description:
The NuGet Package Manager lets you add, update, or remove NuGet packages in your projects without leaving VS Code.

To open the NuGet Manager:

1. Right-click on a project or solution in the Solution Explorer
2. Select **Manage NuGet Packages** from the context menu

This opens a dedicated interface for managing packages.

steps.title: Browsing Available Packages
steps.description:
To find and install new packages:

1. Click the **Browse** tab in the NuGet Manager
2. Enter a search term in the search box
3. Browse the list of available packages
4. Select a package to see its details, including description and versions
5. Click **Install** to add it to your project

You can sort packages by relevance, downloads, or name to find popular and well-maintained packages.

media.altText: Browsing packages in the NuGet Manager

steps.title: Managing Installed Packages
steps.description:
To view and manage packages already installed in your project:

1. Click the **Installed** tab in the NuGet Manager
2. See all packages currently installed in your project
3. Check if updates are available (indicated by an update icon)
4. Click **Update** to upgrade to the latest version
5. Click **Uninstall** to remove a package

You can also view detailed information about each installed package.

media.altText: Managing installed packages in the NuGet Manager

steps.title: Managing Package Sources
steps.description:
The NuGet Manager supports multiple package sources:

1. Default NuGet.org public feed
2. Private feeds (Azure DevOps, MyGet, etc.)
3. Local package sources

You can select the active package source from the dropdown menu in the NuGet Manager. Package sources are read from your NuGet configuration files.

media.altText: Package source selection in the NuGet Manager
